Roles, incentives, and dependencies

Allies

Support shared solar, transparency, and reduced consumption. Households, community cooperatives, and climate groups can benefit from a more accessible energy system.

Potential partners

Platform, installation, hardware, and data providers can help build the system, while bringing business, technical, or regulatory constraints.

Gatekeepers

Control infrastructure, cost, legality, or access. Utilities, pricing, policy, financing, privacy rules, and housing conditions can enable or slow change.

Context & intermediaries

Purple nodes represent landlords, climate pressures, and cultural norms. This descriptive grouping supplements the three categories in the original legend.
